# Overview

Reproduces §3.4 of Oh et al. (2026). RAV-RF on a fixed four-RAV panel
(RAV1166, RAV192, RAV178, RAV188) is compared against an MMR-gene
expression panel (MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2/EPCAM/MLH3/PMS1/MUTYH; negated
mean-z, calibrated to MANTIS via 5-fold-CV linear regression) for
continuous MSI score regression on TCGA COAD+READ Pan-Can Atlas 2018.

The canonical 5-fold-CV numbers reported in the manuscript come from
`benchmark/aim1_msi_score.R`, writing to:

- `results/aim1_msi_score_metrics.rds`
- `results/aim1_msi_score_comparator_metrics.rds`

This vignette is a teaching mirror of the same pipeline; for the
single-source-of-truth artefact use the benchmark script.

# Data dependency

Two cBioPortal files must be present under
`MSI_score_prediction/` in the companion repository:

- `data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt`
- `data_clinical_sample.txt`

from study `coadread_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018`.

# Setup

```{r}
library(InferPheno)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

rav_model <- load_rav_model()
```

# Load expression + clinical

```{r}
exp_file  <- proj_path("MSI_score_prediction/data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt")
clin_file <- proj_path("MSI_score_prediction/data_clinical_sample.txt")

exp <- read_delim(exp_file, delim = "\t", trim_ws = TRUE,
                  escape_double = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(Hugo_Symbol)) |>
  distinct(Hugo_Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  as.data.frame()
rownames(exp) <- exp$Hugo_Symbol
exp$Hugo_Symbol <- NULL
exp$Entrez_Gene_Id <- NULL
exp <- as.matrix(exp)

clin <- read_delim(clin_file, delim = "\t", trim_ws = TRUE,
                   escape_double = FALSE, comment = "#") |>
  filter(SAMPLE_ID %in% colnames(exp), !is.na(MSI_SCORE_MANTIS)) |>
  as.data.frame()

exp <- exp[, clin$SAMPLE_ID]
```

# RAV projection + 5-fold CV

```{r}
rav <- project_to_rav(exp, rav_model)
dat <- data.frame(
  sample_id = clin$SAMPLE_ID,
  cohort    = "COAD_READ",
  phenotype = as.numeric(clin$MSI_SCORE_MANTIS)
)
dat <- cbind(dat, as.data.frame(rav[dat$sample_id, , drop = FALSE]))

selected_ravs <- paste0("RAV", c(1166, 192, 178, 188))

set.seed(1L)
folds <- caret::createFolds(seq_len(nrow(dat)), k = 5L)
oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dat))
for (f in seq_along(folds)) {
  ix <- folds[[f]]
  rf <- randomForest::randomForest(
    x = dat[-ix, selected_ravs, drop = FALSE],
    y = dat$phenotype[-ix],
    ntree = 1000)
  oof[ix] <- predict(rf, newdata = dat[ix, selected_ravs, drop = FALSE])
}
regression_metrics(dat$phenotype, oof)
```

# Comparator (MMR panel)

```{r}
panel <- run_msi_expression_panel(exp)
panel_score <- panel$score[dat$sample_id]
oof_panel <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dat))
for (f in seq_along(folds)) {
  ix <- folds[[f]]
  fit <- lm(y ~ s,
            data = data.frame(y = dat$phenotype[-ix],
                              s = panel_score[-ix]))
  oof_panel[ix] <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(s = panel_score[ix]))
}
regression_metrics(dat$phenotype, oof_panel)
```
